question: Estimate the size of the Indian semiconductor manufacturing opportunity (post-PLI scheme) by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Indian-produced semiconductor industry revenue by 2030? Yes.
Includes fabs (Tata, Vedanta) + ATMP + design? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Tata + Micron + others Fab + ATMP capacity by 2030: ~$15-20B annual revenue capacity (if scheduled fabs come online).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian semiconductor industry revenue 2030: ~$25-30B (~₹2-2.5 lakh Cr).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~₹2-2.5 lakh Cr if PLI execution stays on schedule.
